What should I do if the tracking never updates?
Sorry to hear your tracking isn’t updating. Here’s what to try and what’s normal:
What to expect
• Tracking often updates the evening before delivery or the morning of delivery. A short delay in scans is common.
Steps to take
Check your dispatch email: Confirm the estimated delivery date and courier.
Open the tracking link: Refresh the page/app and, if asked, enter your delivery postcode exactly as on your order.
Courier‑specific tips:
• Royal Mail: It’s normal to see limited updates until a delivery attempt. If there’s no movement by the end of the estimated day, allow one extra working day before contacting us.
• DPD: Tracking is usually live. If it still says “Label created/We’ve received your parcel details” more than 24 hours after shipping, get in touch.
Check for a delivery attempt: Look for a card/email, and check safe places, neighbours, reception/concierge, or communal mail areas.
Verify address details: Make sure the address on the order and on the courier’s page match.
Still no updates? If it’s past the estimated date (or past +1 working day for Royal Mail‑served areas), contact us and we’ll investigate with the courier.
If you’d like me to look into this now, I can check your order and liaise with the courier. Please share your order number and your postcode, and I’ll get started.

• Check around your property and any safe places: porches, bins, sheds, meter cupboards, bike/storage rooms.
• Ask neighbours, reception/concierge, or building management—drivers sometimes leave items nearby.
• Open the tracking page for delivery notes, a delivery photo, or “left in a safe place/with neighbour” messages.
• Confirm the delivery address on the order matches yours.

Can I reroute the package to a different address?
12:04
Short answer: usually not to a different address once it’s on the way.
Here’s what’s possible:
• Before dispatch: We may be able to cancel so you can place a new order to the correct address. Act fast.
• After dispatch: We can’t change the address to a new one, but your courier’s tracking may offer limited options:
– DPD: Often allows delivery to a Pickup Shop, to a neighbour, or changing the delivery date via the DPD link/app.
– Royal Mail: Typically allows redelivery to the same address, collection from the delivery office, or adding a SafePlace note. Changing to a different address isn’t supported.
What to do now:
• Open your tracking link and look for “change delivery” options.
• If you’d like me to check what’s available for your specific order (and whether cancellation/reorder is still possible), share your order number and postcode. If you prefer to move the delivery date instead, include the new date you want and I’ll try to reschedule it if there’s availability.

Do you compensate for a long delay?
We always aim to deliver on time, and if your order was significantly delayed we’ll make it right.
What we can offer (case‑by‑case, depending on the outcome):
• A free replacement on the next available delivery date
• A refund of the delivery fee and/or a goodwill credit
• A partial or full refund if the gift missed the occasion or arrived unusable
When it’s considered delayed:
• Royal Mail: Please allow one extra working day after the estimated delivery date. If it still hasn’t arrived, it’s considered delayed.
• DPD: If the parcel misses the scheduled day or tracking stays on “label created/we’ve received your parcel details” for 24+ hours after dispatch, it’s delayed.
What to do next:
• If you’d like me to review your order and arrange the best remedy, share your order number and your postcode. I’ll check the tracking and confirm the options right away.
• If you prefer, you can also reply with what outcome you’d like (replacement or refund), and I’ll see if we can proceed straight away once I’ve verified the order.
